Hi Samir / TruScale contracts team,

Thanks for sending the draft — attaching our standard MSA template and the Order Form worksheet with fillable fields (see attachments). A few asks from our side to streamline legal review and reduce churn: 

- Can you confirm which counterparty (TruScale Holdings vs TruScale Analytics) should sign the MSA? We need the legal entity name for the signature block and payment terms.
- We typically hand back Exhibit A (billing contacts) and Exhibit C (data handling) as separate files to avoid re-uploading to our billing system. Do you want us to populate those and share for final approval?
- Please provide a single point of contact for procurement and a separate technical contact for SOC 2 evidence requests.
- Preferred signer routing: do you require a pre-sign legal review at your side before DocuSign, or should we send an initial routed envelope with vanilla SOW-level redlines locked?

Attachments: TruScale_Standard_MSA_v1.pdf (redline-ready), OrderForm_Draft.xlsx (billing fields highlighted).

If you can answer the entity + signer routing questions today, we'll draft the signer matrix and kickoff a short legal sprint to close redlines by end of week.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Contracts Operations
